plays.name: Routine hop
plays.cues: Gather right. Field. Step through. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: "Step prep / step step / right creep / left field" needs confirmation.

plays.name: Lateral left, get in front
plays.cues: Prep. Crossover. Shuffle into position. Field. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Get in front before the fielding action.

plays.name: Lateral right, get in front
plays.cues: Prep. Crossover. Shuffle. Field. Step through. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: The throwing transition includes a step through.

plays.name: Routine, cut distance
plays.cues: Adjust. Prep. Left foot, step right. Gather. Step back. Fielding position. Shuffle and throw.
plays.note: The transcript includes a step back during the gather.

plays.name: Drop step forehand
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step. Crossover. Shuffle. Forehand. Step through. Shuffle and throw.
plays.note: The transcript repeats the drop-step wording before the full cue chain.

plays.name: Drop step backhand
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step. Crossover. Shuffle. Backhand field. Shuffle and throw.
plays.note: Forehand and backhand share the drop-step approach.

plays.name: Field through
plays.cues: Hop step. Fielding position. Lean left. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Forward path is an interpretation of the play name.

plays.name: Drop step left forehand
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step left. Shuffle. Forehand. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Repeated "shuffle" cues remain in the source.

plays.name: Drop step right backhand
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step right. Shuffle. Backhand. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Same approach family as Play 8, opposite side.

plays.name: One-hand slow roller left
plays.cues: Prep. Right foot. Step through. Gather right-left. Field. Right-left. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Leftward charging path follows the play name.

plays.name: Drop step crossover backhand
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step. Crossover. Backhand field. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Crossover distinguishes this call from a shuffle-only approach.

plays.name: Drop step right, get in front
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step right. Crossover. Get in front. Field. Step through. Shuffle and throw.
plays.note: The bent route illustrates getting in front, not an exact angle.

plays.name: Routine, come get it, one-hand
plays.cues: Prep. Step right. Creep. Shuffle. Reach. Left shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: The meaning of "left shuffle" needs confirmation.

plays.name: Drop step backhand, lengthen
plays.cues: Prep. Deep drop. Knee drop. Replace. Throw and fall.
plays.note: Confirm "knee drop" and "throw and fall" before teaching exact mechanics.

plays.name: Lateral backhand on the run
plays.cues: Prep. Crossover. Run. Field off right step. Left jump. Throw.
plays.note: "Jump throw" appears before the full cue chain.

plays.name: One-hand chopper
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot. Step right. Catch off left. Throw off right. Follow.
plays.note: Contact-foot cues connect the catch to the throw.

plays.name: Lateral forehand on the run
plays.cues: Prep. Crossover. Run. Field off left. Left shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: "Set feet" appears in the play introduction.

plays.name: Hop field, deep drop, replace feet
plays.cues: Prep. Deep drop. Replace feet. Left shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: No left/right drop direction appears in the supplied cues.

plays.name: Hinge step right backhand
plays.cues: Prep. Hinge step right. Backhand field. Gather. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Hinge path is schematic. The source gives no hinge angle.

plays.name: Backhand, come get it, throw on run
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot step through. Field off right. Left. Right. Throw.
plays.note: Carry the listed foot sequence into the throwing transition.

plays.name: Ball right, one-hand
plays.cues: Set feet. Prep. Left foot. Step right. Field off right.
plays.note: The reliable cue chain stops at fielding. Throwing footwork is unresolved.

plays.name: Routine, cut distance
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot. Step right. Gather right-left. Field. Left shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Controlled gather and shuffle in the supplied call.

plays.name: Do or die, one-hand
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot. Step right. Field off right-left-right. Throw and follow.
plays.note: "Field off right-left-right" needs confirmation as a precise contact sequence.

plays.name: Do or die, barehand
plays.cues: Prep. Run straight. V-cut. "Heel off left." Throw off right. Follow.
plays.note: Confirm "heel off left". The V-cut angle is illustrative.

plays.name: Chopper, come get it, one-hand
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot. Step right. Field off left. Step right. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Raw transcript ends this action with "toefall", an uncertain term.

plays.name: Ball left, routine cut distance
plays.cues: Prep. Right foot. Step left-right-left. Field. Left shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: The ball-left call adds a directional approach to the routine gather.

plays.name: Drop step crossover backhand, no-step throw
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step. Crossover. Field. Load and throw.
plays.note: "No-step throw" appears in the title. Do not add an extra shuffle.

plays.name: Field through boot, barehand
plays.cues: Hop step. Fielding position. Boot ball. Right-left field. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Confirm "boot" and the intended recovery drill. Path shows one possible interpretation.

plays.name: Chopper, stay back, quick exchange
plays.cues: Hop. Step. Gather. Catch off left. Shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Raw wording is "stood back". "Stay back" follows the supplied call sheet.

plays.name: Lateral backhand on run, set feet
plays.cues: Prep. Crossover. Field off left. Replace. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Replace the feet before the listed throw.

plays.name: Routine, cut distance
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot. Step right. Gather right-left. Field. Left shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Repeats Play 22 in the supplied list.

plays.name: Do or die, one-hand
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot. Step right. Field off right-left-right. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Repeats Play 23. Exact contact sequence remains uncertain.

plays.name: Do or die, barehand
plays.cues: Prep. Run straight. V-cut. "Heel off left." Throw off right. Follow.
plays.note: Repeats Play 24. "Heel off left" remains uncertain.

plays.name: Chopper, come get it, one-hand
plays.cues: Prep. Left foot. Step right. Field off left. Step right. "Toe-fall." Throw and follow.
plays.note: Near-duplicate of Play 25. "Toe-fall" remains uncertain.

plays.name: Ball left, routine cut distance
plays.cues: Prep. Right foot. Step left-right-left. Field. Left shuffle. Throw and follow.
plays.note: Repeats Play 26 in the supplied list.

plays.name: Drop step crossover backhand, load and throw
plays.cues: Prep. Drop step. Crossover. Field. Load. Throw.
plays.note: Near-duplicate of Play 27. Title omits "no-step throw".

sequences.title: Routine and lateral positioning
sequences.description: Field a routine hop, then get in front of balls to your left and right.

sequences.title: Adjustment and drop-step routes
sequences.description: Adjust your distance on the routine ball. Use a drop step and crossover on the forehand and backhand.

sequences.title: Field-through and shuffle routes
sequences.description: Work through the routine ball. On either side, drop step and shuffle to the ball.

sequences.title: Slow roller and crossover routes
sequences.description: Charge the slow roller. Use a drop step and crossover for the other two plays.

sequences.title: Charging and moving backhands
sequences.description: Charge the one-hand play, extend for the backhand, then practice the jump throw.

sequences.title: Contact feet and foot replacement
sequences.description: Check which foot you field off and how you set your feet to throw.

sequences.title: Hinge and charging backhands
sequences.description: Compare the hinge-and-gather with two charging plays. Play 21 ends at the catch because its throwing cues are unclear.

sequences.title: Routine gather and urgent charging
sequences.description: Gather on the routine ball. On the do-or-die plays, charge and field with one hand or barehand.

sequences.title: Chopper, ball-left and no-step backhand
sequences.description: Charge the chopper, close on the ball to your left, and load straight into the throw on the backhand.

sequences.title: Recovery and throwing transitions
sequences.description: Practice the recovery, quick exchange, and foot replacement before the throw.

sequences.title: Routine and do-or-die repeat
sequences.description: This group repeats Sequence 8 in the source list.

sequences.title: Chopper and no-step repeat
sequences.description: This group largely repeats Sequence 9, with changes to the wording.
